Support: Chantilly Health reporting intermittent 403 during onboarding provisioning. ~50% of initial API calls failing after key exchange. Customer says no config changes. Marking urgent — potential renewal risk (trial ends in 18 days).
Mira Chen: Can you paste request IDs and exact error strings? cc @Alex @Grace.
Support: Sample IDs: `req_20260321_a17`, `req_20260321_b91`. Error: `403 Forbidden - key mismatch`. Occurred 09:12 and 09:37 PT.
Alex Romero: I'll check token rotation and KMS audit logs. Samir — any cert rolls last night?
Samir Kaur: We ran a cert refresh to staging at 02:00 PT. Prod rollout queued and failed on node-17 due to disk-pressure; retrying now.
Grace (CS): Chantilly's CTO escalated to us. Need comms plan: 1) immediate acknowledgement email, 2) hourly status updates, 3) post-incident summary before renewal discussion. Who owns the customer message?
Mira Chen: I can draft and send the initial email — short, apologetic, ETA for first update: 1 hour. OK?
Alex Romero: Approve. Also enabling a temporary routing to key-service-fallback to reduce failures. I'll post the command.
support-bot: Incident INC-20260321-chantilly-auth created. Priority: high. Assigned: eng-runtime + cs-triage.
Samir Kaur: Re-running the rollout in a controlled batch. Watching KV sync. ETA ~25–35 mins.
Mira Chen: Sending initial email and CCing Grace. Suggest offering a 30-min optional war room update if they want.
Alex Romero: Temporary route applied: `route: tenant=chantilly -> key-service-fallback`. Error rate dropped from ~48% to ~7%.
Jordan Patel: From account health: propose a one-week trial extension or credit if any recurrence. Coordinate legal on wording.
Grace (CS): Noted. I'll lock a mitigation note in the renewal tracker and propose moving the renewal call out 3 days to ensure stability.
Samir Kaur: Rollout succeeded; node-17 healthy; KV sync complete. No 403s in the last 12 minutes.
Support: Customer confirms service restored. Thanks all.
Mira Chen: I'll send a post-resolution summary and an exec-facing note. Alex — please prepare a root-cause blurb for the postmortem. Jordan — draft credit language if needed. Reconvene in 24h for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
